settings.tagline: Your images, ready for your Flows.
settings.empty_text: Upload a JPEG or PNG, then select it in the print action of your Flow.
settings.flow_step1: Choose your printer in the Then section.
settings.flow_step2: Add Print an image from the library.
settings.flow_step3: Search for the image by name.
settings.persist_note: Images stay on Homey through restarts and app updates. When you replace an image, your Flows keep using it. Limit: 50 MB in total, 10 MB per file.
settings.backup_note: Export a copy before uninstalling the app or resetting Homey. The backup keeps the links used in your Flows.
settings.text_label: What do you want to print?
settings.text_placeholder: A list, a reminder, a message…
settings.print_note: Paper, colour and text size are set in the printer’s advanced settings. Files chosen here are printed without being added to the library.
settings.manage_note: Name and file can change: your Flows stay linked to this image.
settings.no_printer: Add a printer from Devices → + → Network Print.
settings.file_limit: Choose a JPEG or PNG of at most 10 MB.
settings.added: Images saved to Homey: __count__. You can now choose them in your Flows.
settings.backup_ready: Backup ready. Keep the file somewhere safe.
settings.backup_invalid: This file is not a valid Network Print backup.
settings.backup_replace_confirm: The backup contains images that are already in the library. Replace them and keep the links in your Flows?
settings.imported: Images imported: __count__. The original Flow links are preserved.
settings.sending: Preparing and sending to the printer…
settings.sent: Pages sent to the queue: __count__. Check the printer output.
settings.name_saved: Name updated. The link in your Flows is preserved.
settings.replaced: File replaced. Your Flows will use the new image.
settings.delete_confirm: Permanently delete this image? Flows that use it will no longer be able to print it. You can export a backup first.
settings.choose_image: Choose an image or enter its URL.

pair.title: Choose the printer
pair.intro: Connect it directly to Homey. You can search the network or enter its address.
pair.shared_note: Queues published by a NAS or another computer.
pair.selfsigned: Accept the self-signed certificate of this trusted local printer.
pair.selfsigned_note: Some printers, including the Epson ET-8550, need this option for an encrypted connection.
pair.verify_note: Verification does not start a print.
pair.secure_selected: Encrypted connection selected. Check the certificate option before adding.
pair.found: Select a printer or enter an address.
pair.none: No printers found. Enter the printer’s IP address.
